text: Judge Antonia Arteaga For Chief Justice, 4th Court of Appeals
[image: 32 counties. One proven leader. Judge Arteaga has the experience, the trust, and the heart for her community. Prepared to lead as Chief Justice.]
[image: Arteaga Park carries my family’s name and a strong connection to my ancestors who helped build Del Rio. That connection is what grounds me in serving our community.]
[image: At Laredo College with future legal professionals, stressing the importance of connecting and networking in spaces like this. It can make a difference. 📚⚖️]

[image: Judge Antonia “Toni” Arteaga, your nominee for Chief Justice of the 4th Court of Appeals. ⚖️ ]

[image: Two full-time jobs, one very good playlist. ☀️ By day I’m a sitting District Court Judge. Before and after, I’m also campaigning for Chief Justice of the 4th Court of Appeals, which serves 32 counties. Grateful for all the positive energy! Please keep it coming. ]
